requires: failed accessibility audit or existing artifact needing accessibility repair
forbidden: new Bricks elements unless explicitly required and explained
new classes unless official/project-token mapping cannot solve the failure
preserve: global variable names unless adding documented accessibility token mappings

darkModeRecipe.sourceOfTruth: Use this recipe; do not search repo docs for a separate dark-mode contract.
darkModeRecipe.bricksCompatibility: When the target Bricks site exposes frontend color mode, Bricks may set document.documentElement.dataset.brxTheme on the frontend and emit palette variables at :root plus :root[data-brx-theme="dark"]. Bricks-ready accessibility fixes must support data-brx-theme alongside Kiwe data-kiwe-theme when available; do not rely on Bricks editor dark UI alone.
darkModeRecipe.rule: For artifacts already targeting Kiwe, Seam, AppShell, or Bricks, remap their existing project variables to Kiwe tokens for light and dark states without inventing a second palette. For framework-neutral raw HTML/CSS/JS, preserve project-owned semantic variables and use artifact-native data-theme state; do not introduce Kiwe, Seam, or Bricks solely for accessibility.

checks: full-page light/dark rendered inspection at desktop/tablet/mobile/narrow
semantic project token pairs; Kiwe/Seam pairs only when that framework is already in scope
Bricks theme-style alignment only for a Bricks target
critical text wrapping, clipping, overlap and viewport overflow
card flex/grid growth and equal-height resilience
closureValidator: Run validate-accessibility.cjs <artifact-root> --closure. Require plan.closure.approvedDesignPreserved, lightModeArtDirectionPreserved, darkModeArtDirection, darkModeParityReview, responsiveUsabilityReviewed, repeatedComponentsReviewed and passed light/dark proof at desktop/tablet/mobile/narrow. A non-zero or unavailable result must not be labelled PASS or complete; return the corrected candidate artifact as STATUS: NEEDS_INPUT with the missing proof.
finalResponse: Return fixed file(s), PASS/FAIL/WARN, files changed, and structural-drift summary. Keep it compact.
